parameters.help_en:
The remediation setting ID.

For information about how to obtain a remediation setting ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270772.html
parameters.help_zh:
修正设置ID。

关于如何获取修正设置ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270772.html
parameters.name: remediation_id

parameters.help_en:
The remediation type. Valid values:
OOS: CloudOps Orchestration Service (template-based remediation).
FC: Function Compute (custom remediation)
parameters.help_zh:
修正类型。取值：
OOS：运维编排（模板修正）。
FC：函数计算（自定义修正）
parameters.name: remediation_type

parameters.help_en:
The remediation template ID.

For information about how to obtain a remediation template ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270066.html
parameters.help_zh:
修正模板ID。

关于如何获取修正模板ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/270066.html
parameters.name: remediation_template_id

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the remediation. Valid values:
NON_EXECUTION: not executed.
AUTO_EXECUTION: automatically executed.
MANUAL_EXECUTION: manually executed.
NOT_CONFIG: not configured
parameters.help_zh:
修正执行方式。取值：
NON_EXECUTION：不执行。
AUTO_EXECUTION：自动执行。
MANUAL_EXECUTION：手动执行。
NOT_CONFIG：未设置
parameters.name: invoke_type

parameters.help_en:
The source of the remediation execution. Valid values:
ALIYUN: official remediation.
CUSTOM: custom remediation.
NONE: none
parameters.help_zh:
执行修正来源。取值：
ALIYUN：官方修正。

CUSTOM：自定义修正。

NONE：无
parameters.name: source_type

parameters.help_en: The parameters of the remediation setting
parameters.name: params

parameters.help_en: Ensures the idempotence of the request. Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. The ClientToken value supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token
